title: Wo khoon ro ke
body:
wo khoon ro ke ye kehta raha zamane se
ridayein cheeno na logon mere gharane se
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaal e aab pe sone pe us ke rone pe
wo maarte thay sakina ko har bahaane se
wo khoon ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sulaaya jaata tha behosh kar ke durron se
jagaya jaata tha abid ko taziyane se
wo khoon ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bulaye kis tarha abbas ko madad ke liye
wo berida thi jhijhakti rahi bulaane se
wo khoon ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye ganje shaheedan may baap ke sar ne
mujhe sakina bulaati hai qaid khaane se
wo khoon ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch is tarha sar e karbobala wo ujde thay
ke darr rahe hai abhi tak wo ghar basaane se
wo khoon ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
rida e saani e zehra may dhal gaya akbar
ghubaar utha jo laashon ke thar tharaane se
wo khoon ro ke...
author: Hasnain Akbar
